defense_news.title: US approves possible $800 million military helicopter sale to Iraq
defense_news.summary: The United States has approved a potential $800 million sale of Bell helicopters, weapons and related equipment to Iraq, according to the State Department.

defense_news.title: US launches new barrage of strikes on Iran around Strait of Hormuz
defense_news.summary: The U.S. launched new air strikes on Iranian targets Tuesday following attempted attacks by the IRGC against American troops deployed to the region.

defense_news.title: American Rheinmetall delivers its first prototype to replace Bradley Fighting Vehicle
defense_news.summary: The move is the latest in the service’s yearslong effort to replace the Bradley Fighting Vehicle.

defense_news.title: US tech found in Russian ballistic missiles
defense_news.summary: Dozens of American- and European-made components are still being used to build Russia’s deadly ballistic missiles.
